issues.explanation: The light border surrounding the search input field lacks sufficient visual contrast against the background, making the primary input boundary difficult to distinguish.
issues.suggested_fix: Darken the border color of the search input box to achieve at least a 3:1 contrast ratio against the white background.

issues.explanation: Multiple competing elements for posting an ad exist simultaneously in the top header and left sidebar with conflicting visual styles, obscuring the primary user action path.
issues.location_in_image: post an ad button on left sidebar
issues.suggested_fix: Consolidate the post action into one clear, visually dominant call-to-action button in the main top header.

issues.explanation: The four-column link grid inside the discussion forums box has overly tight column spacing, causing adjacent topic names to run together and impair legibility.
issues.suggested_fix: Increase horizontal padding between the forum grid columns and add vertical line spacing between links.

issues.explanation: The calendar day header labels use faint text on a light gray fill, making the column headers hard to read for users with visual impairments.
issues.suggested_fix: Increase the contrast ratio of the day header text against the gray background fill to at least 4.5:1.
